words.gloss_range: responsive connector with causal and resumptive force at the ayah boundary
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the ayah begin as an answer to 52:44, where the deniers would explain away a falling sky-fragment. Its force is both consequential and resumptive: the command that follows is caused by that refusal and also launches a new imperative unit. Because the particle is bound into {{ar:فَذَرْهُمْ}} ({{tr:fa-dharhum}}), the response does not pause between diagnosis and withdrawal. The same opening also belongs to the recognized dismissal formula found with the same command pattern in 43:83 and 70:42.

topics.headline: connector makes withdrawal a response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not start a detached warning; {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the withdrawal command answer the failed perception in 52:44.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as sequential or resultative, and the CRITICAL boundary rows consistently tie it to the denial scene in 52:44.

topics.headline: bound particle fuses consequence to command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first sound is not detachable setup; it arrives bound to the command and turns observation into prescribed disengagement.
topics.reason: The row family treats the particle as the fused opening of {{ar:فَذَرْهُمْ}} ({{tr:fa-dharhum}}), which is consistent with the particle-plus-imperative surface.

topics.headline: opening joins a repeated dismissal formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is not a one-off transition; the same fa-command frame recurs in dismissal passages at 43:83 and 70:42.
topics.reason: The supplied parallel row gives the same formulaic opening at 43:83, 52:45, and 70:42.

words.gloss_range: direct 2ms command to leave the same plural group, with the attached object suffix making the target explicit
words.root_gloss_range: defective leave or let-alone root; local form selects forward command and disengagement, while unrelated root-family claims are not active

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: endpoint particle that bounds the leave-command

words.prose: {{ar:ذَرْهُمْ}} ({{tr:dharhum}}) is a direct imperative, not a report that they have already been abandoned. The attached plural object keeps the deniers from 52:44 as the target, so the scene shifts from their speech to a commanded response toward the same group. The short surface compresses command and object into one abrupt dismissal before the endpoint opens. The root and form make the leaving forward-facing: this defective verb is available here as command, and {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:hatta}}) immediately gives that command an endpoint. The result is threatening withdrawal, not casual permission: reminder has reached its limit after 52:29, and the repeated formula at 43:83 and 70:42 shows this command as eschatological deferral until encounter.

topics.headline: imperative targets the same deniers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:ذَرْهُمْ}} ({{tr:dharhum}}) converts the prior diagnosis into an addressed command, while the suffix keeps the same deniers in view.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a 2ms imperative with a 3mp object suffix resuming the discourse group.

topics.headline: defective command makes withdrawal forward-facing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the leaving is not narrated as past completion; the defective imperative makes withdrawal a live instruction whose endpoint lies ahead.
topics.reason: The local root is the accepted leaving branch of {{ar:و ذ ر}} ({{tr:w-dh-r}}), and the imperative is bounded by the following endpoint clause.

topics.headline: leaving functions as threat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that leaving them is itself the threat: human engagement is withdrawn so the deferred Day becomes the operative answer.
topics.reason: The command is immediately scoped by the endpoint clause, so the local force is disengagement until encounter rather than temporary neglect.

topics.headline: command joins formula and marks a limit after reminder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a double placement: the command echoes the dismissal formula at 43:83 and 70:42 while answering the reminder command of 52:29.
topics.reason: The supplied rows give both the cross-surah formula at 43:83 and 70:42 and the same-surah movement from reminder in 52:29 to leaving in 52:45.

topics.headline: short command and suffix make dismissal clipped
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how compact the dismissal is: command and object are compressed into one abrupt word before the endpoint opens.
topics.reason: The surface joins the imperative stem to the object suffix in one word, matching the CRITICAL observations about compact command shape.

topics.headline: warning-root reversal is not locally supported
topics.blocking_evidence: The local word is aligned to {{ar:و ذ ر}} ({{tr:w-dh-r}}), while the warner term invoked by the CRITICAL rows belongs to a different root shape and is not supported by the local QAC or V4 evidence.
topics.reason: The local root evidence supports leaving or letting be under {{ar:و ذ ر}} ({{tr:w-dh-r}}), so the claimed same-root tension with warning is blocked.

words.gloss_range: endpoint and purpose particle governing the projected encounter clause
words.prose: {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:hatta}}) is the hinge between command and future endpoint, moving the discourse from the present refusal of 52:44 into the Day-scene of 52:45. It governs the following encounter verb, so the leaving is neither aimless nor indefinite; it lasts until the point where they meet their Day. The particle keeps both temporal and purposive pressure: the command waits until the Day, and that waiting lets the encounter become the decisive answer. Its doubled consonant gives the small particle acoustic weight at exactly the place where the ayah holds the command under pressure.

topics.headline: particle scopes leaving to the future endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:hatta}}) keeps the command open only until the fixed encounter arrives.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the particle the endpoint-purpose link governing the encounter clause.

topics.headline: hinge moves from denial-now to Day-scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scene change: the particle moves from present refusal in 52:44 to the eschatological endpoint in 52:45.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL boundary rows preserve the particle's role in shifting the discourse from human disengagement to the encounter scene.

topics.headline: gemination weights the endpoint particle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the small endpoint particle is acoustically heavy, matching its role as the pressure point between command and future meeting.
topics.reason: The phonetic row has local payoff because the doubled consonant coincides with the structural hinge.

words.gloss_range: governed future encounter with the Day as explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: meeting and encounter branch is active; casting and other remote branches may color contact only where locally narrowed

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: encounter verb that takes the Day as object

words.prose: {{ar:يُلَٰقُوا۟}} ({{tr:yulaqu}}) is subordinated under {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:hatta}}), so the meeting is the terminal condition of leaving, not a loose second prediction. Its plural agreement keeps the same deniers moving through the ayah, and its object is the Day they must encounter. The meeting branch makes the Day more than a date: it becomes the counterpart they come up against. The casting branch only lightly shades this as being brought into unavoidable contact; it does not replace the local meeting sense. Variant and form rows sharpen that pressure without replacing the base reading: the canonical form keeps stronger face-to-face encounter, while other readings show how agency could be heard from the deniers' side. The phrase also belongs to the repeated dismissal formula at 43:83 and 70:42, and within this surah it resonates with the forced punishment scene of 52:13. Its cadence lingers at the meeting before the relative clause tightens the Day's identity.

topics.headline: encounter verb is the governed endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:يُلَٰقُوا۟}} ({{tr:yulaqu}}) is projected but fixed: it is the endpoint governed by {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:hatta}}), not an uncertain aside.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as subjunctive under {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:hatta}}), and attachment evidence makes the clause the endpoint-purpose unit.

topics.headline: plural agreement carries the same group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ones left in the command are the same ones who meet the Day and later suffer the passive collapse.
topics.reason: The 3mp agreement is controlled by the same discourse group resumed by the object suffix.

topics.headline: meeting makes the Day an encountered counterpart
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Day is not merely when something happens; it is what they meet as an unavoidable counterpart.
topics.reason: The meeting branch of {{ar:ل ق ي}} ({{tr:l-q-y}}) is locally selected by the explicit Day object; broader claims about the Day's agency are kept as encounter pressure rather than a separate personification.

topics.headline: variant readings expose encounter agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that agency in the encounter is a real pressure point, even though the base reading keeps the deniers in third-person governed encounter.
topics.reason: The variant rows are useful as contrast, but they do not replace the canonical local parse of the 3mp governed verb.

topics.headline: casting branch colors forced contact only lightly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a secondary sense of being brought into contact, while the local verb still means meeting the Day.
topics.reason: V4 lists casting as a separate branch of {{ar:ل ق ي}} ({{tr:l-q-y}}), so it may shade contact but cannot replace the locally selected encounter sense.

topics.headline: encounter phrase belongs to a repeated formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the encounter clause is formulaic across 43:83 and 70:42, while 52:13 gives same-surah pressure from forced doom.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply exact parallels at 43:83 and 70:42 and a same-surah comparison with 52:13.

topics.headline: cadence slows at the encounter phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase lingers at the meeting before the relative clause tightens the Day's identity.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is retained because the cadence coincides with the verb-object encounter point.

words.gloss_range: their appointed Day, functioning as encountered object and temporal frame
words.root_gloss_range: day or decisive time range narrowed here by suffix and relative clause to an appointed reckoning

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: encounter verb that takes the Day as object

words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمَهُمُ}} ({{tr:yawmahum}}) personalizes the endpoint: it is their Day, not a generic date. As the object of {{ar:يُلَٰقُوا۟}} ({{tr:yulaqu}}), the Day is what they meet; as a temporal noun carried into the relative clause, it is also the frame inside which the passive collapse occurs. The singular possessed form compresses their trajectory into one appointed reckoning, and the following relative clause specifies that appointment by its event. This word is also the formula's endpoint anchor in 43:83 and 70:42, gathers the surah's Day-thread from 52:9, 52:11, and 52:13, and points forward to the next Day reference in 52:46.

topics.headline: possessive suffix makes the Day theirs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Day is individualized by the suffix: the endpoint belongs to the same deniers' own trajectory.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the 3mp possessive suffix and connect it with the same discourse group.

topics.headline: Day is both encountered object and event frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a double function: they meet the Day as the object of encounter, and that same Day contains the event in which they are struck.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the noun the object of the encounter verb; the temporal-frame pressure survives through the relative clause and resumptive pronoun, so the topic is narrowed rather than made an alternative parse.

topics.headline: ordinary day narrows to appointed reckoning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a common day-word is locally tightened into an appointed reckoning by possession and the defining relative clause.
topics.reason: The broader day or period range is real, but the local suffix and relative clause select the eschatological appointment.

topics.headline: Day anchors the dismissal formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the possessed Day is the stable endpoint of the dismissal formula also found at 43:83 and 70:42.
topics.reason: The supplied exact parallels make the verb-object phrase a formulaic deferral frame at 43:83, 52:45, and 70:42.

topics.headline: Day pivots from encounter to definition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word sits at the hinge: first it is met, then it is defined by the event inside it.
topics.reason: The noun is both the object of the encounter verb and the antecedent of the following relative clause.

topics.headline: possessed Day gathers and extends the surah thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this possessed Day gathers earlier Day warnings in 52:9, 52:11, and 52:13 and leads into 52:46.
topics.reason: The supplied same-surah rows list earlier and following Day references, with 52:45 serving as personalized endpoint.

topics.headline: generic frequency count adds no local payoff
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The broad frequency claim is too generic; the local payoff is already preserved by the suffix, formula, and surah-thread topics.
topics.reason: A high occurrence count does not by itself add a distinct reader-facing point beyond the retained local specialization.

words.gloss_range: masculine singular relative pronoun attaching the defining clause to the Day
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhi}}) locks the following clause onto {{ar:يَوْمَهُمُ}} ({{tr:yawmahum}}), not onto the plural deniers. Its masculine singular agreement keeps the Day as the antecedent, and its relative function turns what follows into the Day's definition rather than a new independent event. The Day is first personalized, then identified by what happens in it. The liaison from {{ar:يَوْمَهُمُ}} ({{tr:yawmahum}}) into {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhi}}) helps the defining clause feel attached rather than restarted.

topics.headline: agreement fixes the Day as antecedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the relative clause defines the Day, not the plural deniers, because {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhi}}) agrees with the masculine singular Day noun.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the relative pronoun as the modifier of {{ar:يَوْمَهُمُ}} ({{tr:yawmahum}}), with masculine singular agreement.

topics.headline: relative clause defines the Day by event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Day is identified by the collapse-event inside it rather than by a separate title.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun opens a clause that modifies the Day and supplies its identifying content.

topics.headline: fixed definite form and liaison attach the clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the defining clause enters as a specific attached characterization, not as an indefinite or hard-restarted addition.
topics.reason: The fixed relative form and recitational liaison support attachment of the characterization beat to the Day noun.

words.gloss_range: fronted prepositional pronoun phrase locating the event inside that Day
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهِ}} ({{tr:fihi}}) points back to {{ar:يَوْمَهُمُ}} ({{tr:yawmahum}}) and locates the collapse inside that Day. The preposition selects temporal containment here, not a vague circumstance, because the pronoun resumes the Day named just before it. Its fronted position also matters: the relative clause gives the frame before the event, so the reader hears "in it" before the passive strike. That order makes the Day the foregrounded container where the final verb becomes intelligible.

topics.headline: pronoun phrase locates the event in the Day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:فِيهِ}} ({{tr:fihi}}) makes the Day the temporal container of the strike, not merely background or cause.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence ties the pronoun suffix back to the Day and makes the phrase the locative complement of the passive verb.

topics.headline: fronting foregrounds the Day before the strike
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the relative clause is frame-first and event-second, so the Day is foregrounded before the passive collapse is named.
topics.reason: The fronted prepositional phrase precedes the passive verb and gives the event its specific Day-frame.

topics.headline: future scene is localized inside the Day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary movement from the visible scene in 52:44 into the precise future Day-frame of 52:45.
topics.reason: The phrase supplies the frame before content and localizes the future event away from the present visual field of 52:44.

words.gloss_range: Form IV passive: they are made thunderstruck, stunned, or collapsed, with the agent unexpressed
words.root_gloss_range: thunderbolt, blast, stunned unconsciousness, and death-by-shock branches converge locally in passive collapse
words.prose: {{ar:يُصْعَقُونَ}} ({{tr:yus'aquna}}) is the ayah's final impact word. Its plural ending closes the same referent chain: the ones left, the ones who meet, are the ones struck. The passive suppresses the striker, so the deniers stand in the foreground as patients of an overwhelming event. The root fuses thunderbolt force with loss of sense, making the endpoint feel like both impact and incapacitation, and the emphatic, pharyngeal, and uvular consonants give that strike audible weight. Variant readings expose the agency pressure without displacing the base reading: the canonical passive frames collapse as received force, while active variants let the terror register from the experiencers' side. The word also carries Day-scale resonance from 39:68, contrasts with the overwhelming manifestation at 7:143, echoes thunderbolt-punishment scenes at 41:13, 41:17, and 51:44, and closes the ayah by moving from active human command to passive consequence. Across the boundary, the confident speech of 52:44 is answered by speech-nullifying collapse in 52:45.

topics.headline: final plural verb closes the same referent chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the passive event belongs to the same group and defines the Day inside the relative clause.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence keep the 3mp group continuous and place the verb inside the relative clause modifying the Day.

topics.headline: passive suppresses the striker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source of the strike is not named; the grammar foregrounds their being overcome rather than an explicit agent.
topics.reason: The local form is passive, and attachment evidence explicitly marks the agent as suppressed.

topics.headline: variant readings expose collapse agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same collapse can be heard as received force in the base reading and as experienced terror in active variants, without changing the canonical passive parse.
topics.reason: The qiraat rows are retained as contrast while the base output remains governed by the canonical Form IV passive in QAC.

topics.headline: root fuses thunder impact and unconscious collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb is not generic punishment; it merges thunderbolt force with being stunned or senseless.
topics.reason: V4 supports thunderbolt and stunned-senseless branches, and the local passive verb makes those branches converge in the final event.

topics.headline: rare root carries Day-scale punishment resonance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rare root draws on Day-scale collapse at 39:68, overwhelming manifestation at 7:143, and thunderbolt-punishment scenes at 41:13, 41:17, and 51:44.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete root echoes and distributional pressure without importing those scenes as the local narrative.

topics.headline: final passive transfers the ayah into consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural landing: the ayah opens with an active command and closes with passive collapse.
topics.reason: The final word supplies the event that defines the Day and completes the movement from commanded disengagement to suffered consequence.

topics.headline: heavy consonants make the strike audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the emphatic, pharyngeal, and uvular consonant sequence gives the closing verb audible weight.
topics.reason: The sound-texture rows have local payoff because they converge with the final-position thunder-collapse image.

topics.headline: dismissive speech becomes speechless collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary reversal from 52:44 to 52:45: their confident speech after seeing a sign ends in passive, speech-nullifying collapse.
topics.reason: The boundary rows connect the falling sign and dismissive speech in 52:44 with the people themselves being overcome in 52:45.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The word-1 imperative, the until-clause, the encounter verb at word 3, the possessive day at word 4, and the passive predicate at word 7.
baseline_models.mechanism: Non-intervention opens a bounded interval whose terminus is not merely a date but their own severe occasion, met face-to-face, where agency gives way to being struck senseless.

activation_trace.role: Leaving or letting something be supplies the controlled non-intervention that begins the interval.
Face-to-face convergence turns the terminus from an arriving date into an encounter.
A severe event-day makes the possessive day an occurrence proper to them, not only a calendar unit.
Being struck senseless or dead supplies the passive loss of agency at the encounter.

changed_reading.before: Withdraw from them until a future day when they die.
changed_reading.after: Let them proceed untouched only until they come face-to-face with an event that is theirs and that terminates their agency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The locative relation between the possessive event-day and the passive word-7 predicate.
baseline_models.mechanism: The day can be carried as an acoustic and vertical impact: an ill encountered as a harsh, sky-borne crash that overwhelms sense, rather than death named without a medium.

activation_trace.role: What one meets of good or ill frames the day as something that befalls them.
The notable severe occasion gives the acoustic impact an event-container.
A harsh piercing sound keeps an acoustic cause active inside the passive predicate.
A sky-borne crash adds downward material force and the possibility of punishment or death.

changed_reading.before: They will simply be rendered unconscious or killed on that day.
changed_reading.after: Their event arrives as an encountered overhead crash whose sound and force undo consciousness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The lexical sequence from word-1 release to word-3 meeting, bounded by the until-clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: A material branch of the opening root images a detached piece; the encounter root can image making two ends meet. The verse can therefore carry a separation-to-reconvergence trajectory whose final joining is catastrophic.

activation_trace.role: A detached piece supplies an exploratory material image for releasing the addressed collective into separation.
Making two sides meet converts the later encounter into forced reconvergence.
An open span of time accommodates the interval across which separated trajectories continue.
The stunned or dead endpoint makes reconvergence terminal rather than restorative.

changed_reading.before: Ignore a group until punishment occurs.
changed_reading.after: Release the collective into dispersal until its separated trajectories are made to converge at a shared, agency-ending shock.

context_deltas.mechanism: Their watch for the messenger's terminating turn is answered by reciprocal waiting and then by release until their own event. The focus imperative is strategic temporal reversal, not simple disengagement.

activation_trace.role: Letting them be supplies the non-intervention by which their chosen waiting continues.
Their severe occasion replaces the endpoint they expected for someone else.
Waiting and watching supplies their hostile temporal posture toward the messenger.
Reciprocal waiting turns their posture back upon them and keeps the contest open.
Cutting an extension until it ceases supplies the terminal outcome they imagine for the messenger and that the focus redirects.

structural_cues: The subject of waiting moves from their first-person stance, to a reciprocal command and response, to a third-person instruction to leave them until their own day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hostile waiting, reciprocal waiting, and an imagined cutoff; I infer their target's end -> reversal -> their event, while the live alternative is rhetorical postponement without a designed temporal contest.

changed_reading.before: The speaker simply stops arguing with them until judgment.
changed_reading.after: Their attempt to wait out the messenger is allowed to run until the waiting relation reverses and terminates in their own event.

context_deltas.mechanism: Crossing a limit in rebellion activates the until-clause as a trajectory boundary. Leaving them is not empty delay but permission for excess to continue until it encounters the severe event that exposes its limit.

activation_trace.role: Letting them continue supplies the unblocked trajectory of excess.
Face-to-face meeting converts an abstract limit into an encountered boundary.
The severe occasion supplies the event-form in which the boundary manifests.
Exceeding a limit through rebellion supplies the directional process that the focus allows to run.

structural_cues: The description of them as a people beyond bounds precedes a long interrogative exposure of their claims and then the until-boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limit-crossing and the focus supplies release-until-encounter; I infer continued excess -> manifested limit, while the live alternative is an externally fixed day unrelated to the internal course of transgression.

changed_reading.before: The delay is arbitrary postponement before a scheduled punishment.
changed_reading.after: They are released along their own overreaching trajectory until its limit takes event-form and faces them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly gives them control through utterance: accusation, fabricated attribution, a demanded comparable discourse, claimed hearing, and verbal relabeling of sight. The acoustic branch of the focus shock ends that regime with sound that acts on the body before it can be managed as another claim.

activation_trace.role: Receiving or imparting speech keeps a communicative branch live inside the encounter verb.
A harsh piercing sound supplies the non-discursive acoustic event that terminates verbal control.
Producing spoken assertion supplies their first mode of controlling the situation through labels.
Saying what did not occur supplies fabricated attribution as a stronger form of verbal control.
Renewed report or discourse supplies the speech-object they are challenged to produce.
Auditory perception supplies the claimed channel through which hidden information would be received.
Speech functioning as conjecture supplies the label imposed on a directly seen falling object.

structural_cues: A chain of speaking, producing a discourse, listening, and naming a seen object immediately precedes the focus predicate's acoustic possibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated verbal and auditory mediation; I infer managed speech -> unmanageable sound -> bodily collapse, while the live alternative is that the focus root foregrounds death rather than acoustics.

changed_reading.before: The argument ends and an unrelated punishment follows.
changed_reading.after: Their speech-controlled world is allowed to continue until the event answers as raw sound that cannot remain a claim and instead acts upon them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Claims to guarded stores, supervisory control, possession of the hidden, and binding writing are all denied before the focus. The possessive day is therefore ironic: it is theirs as liability and exposure, not theirs to store, author, or administer.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face meeting makes them recipients of the event rather than its supervisors.
The possessive severe occasion supplies belonging as exposure rather than mastery.
Passive loss of sense or life supplies the final absence of operational control.
Guarding and preserving supplies the storehouse control rhetorically denied to them.
Supervisory domination supplies the administrative control they are asked whether they possess.
Concealment from sight supplies the domain they cannot possess as information.
Writing that fixes judgment or destiny supplies authorship and determination denied to their practice.

structural_cues: The rhetorical sequence asks whether stores are with them, whether they control, and whether the hidden is with them so that they write; the focus then calls the day theirs while making them passive within it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied mastery over stores, oversight, hidden knowledge, and fixing inscription; I infer possessive day = assigned exposure rather than owned control, while the live alternative is that the possessive marks only destination.

changed_reading.before: Their day belongs to them as a neutral way of naming their appointed time.
changed_reading.after: Their day belongs to them as an inescapable liability precisely where every claimed mode of ownership, authorship, and control is absent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The plot is already reflexively turned onto its makers, and immediately after the focus it loses both efficacy and allied help. Meeting their day is the point where engineered control closes around them and every external support fails.

activation_trace.role: Encountering ill supplies the point at which the plot's result returns as their experience.
The severe occasion supplies the threshold at which strategy becomes ineffective.
Cunning manipulation supplies both their intended instrument and the context's reflexive reversal onto them.
The same instrument appears after the focus as incapable of producing its intended escape.
Sufficiency supplies the efficacy explicitly denied to their strategy at the day.
Aid and making prevail supplies the social rescue channel also denied at the terminus.

structural_cues: A passive reversal of the plot precedes the focus, while the next verse repeats the plot and negates both its efficacy and their being helped.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reflexive plotting, failed efficacy, and absent aid; I infer self-turned strategy -> terminal enclosure at their day, while the live alternative is three independent descriptions of defeat.

changed_reading.before: Their punishment arrives independently of their present schemes.
changed_reading.after: Their day is where their own control-system completes its reversal, cannot avail, and cannot recruit rescue.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, a visibly falling detached piece is verbally stabilized as an ordinary piled cloud. The focus's detached-piece branch and sky-crash branch allow a material reading in which interpretive distancing lasts only until the apparent object becomes bodily impact.

activation_trace.role: A detached piece supplies the focus-side material echo of the fragment they dismiss.
A sky-borne crash converts a distant overhead object into bodily force.
Direct sight supplies evidence that is present before their verbal reinterpretation.
A piece detached from a body or the sky supplies the falling object's discrete material form.
Falling downward supplies the object's trajectory toward contact.
A cloud drawn along supplies the ordinary category into which they place the threatening object.
Piling one thing above another supplies the harmless-looking organization asserted by their label.

structural_cues: The immediately preceding verse uses a perception-to-speech chain: they see a falling object and then rename it before the instruction to leave them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sight, detached material, descent, and a cloud-heap label; I infer misclassification -> delayed recognition -> impact, while the live alternative is simple obstinacy with no material continuity into the focus shock.

changed_reading.before: They ignore a sign and are later struck in an unrelated scene.
changed_reading.after: They are left inside a distancing misclassification until the detached overhead object can no longer remain a label and arrives as force.

context_deltas.mechanism: A punitive event below or short of the named terminus remains live before the final day, while lack of disclosure prevents recognition. The until-clause marks the terminal threshold, not a punishment-free interval.

activation_trace.role: Letting them continue supplies the interval in which nearer consequences can occur without ending the trajectory.
The severe event-day remains the terminal occasion beyond lesser or nearer pressure.
Painful punishment supplies a real adverse event distinct from the final threshold.
Nearness short of a goal supplies the layered relation between prior penalty and the named terminus.
Disclosure to a knower, here negated for most, supplies why nearer consequences may remain unread.

structural_cues: The post-focus sequence first describes the day as disabling strategy, then names a punishment short of that while negating most people's knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies punishment short of the referent and non-disclosure; I infer prior pressure -> final day rather than empty delay -> final day, while the live alternative is that short-of marks rank or location rather than time.

changed_reading.before: Leaving them until their day postpones all consequence until one terminal date.
changed_reading.after: They continue through partly unread nearer penalties, but the until-clause reserves a distinct terminal event where the trajectory closes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus command frames leaving as disciplined self-restraint under judgment, active oversight, and timed worship. Non-intervention is therefore an obedient mode of action with supervision and rhythm, not abandonment of responsibility.

activation_trace.role: Letting them be supplies the outward non-intervention whose inward discipline context clarifies.
Restraining the self from panic supplies the agentive labor inside apparent inaction.
Judgment between parties supplies the governing order to which the restraint belongs.
Protective observation supplies oversight, preventing the leaving from reading as isolation.
Worshipful praise supplies the positive practice that occupies the interval of restraint.
Assigning a known time to action supplies a disciplined temporal rhythm alongside the larger until-clause.

structural_cues: After the plural object is released to its trajectory, the address returns to the singular recipient through imperatives of patience and praise plus an assurance of observation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, judgment, oversight, worship, and timed action; I infer obedience -> bounded non-intervention, while the live alternative is independent consolation after a command whose force remains simple disengagement.

changed_reading.before: Leave them means cease engagement because nothing more can be done.
changed_reading.after: Leave them means hold a supervised, worship-filled restraint while judgment, rather than the addressee, carries their trajectory to its limit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links a claimed ladder for celestial listening to the acoustic branch of the focus shock. It remains valid because the focus predicate itself carries piercing sound and the context pairs ascent, hearing, and demanded compelling proof. Render it only as an auditory-epistemic reversal, not as identity between the ladder and the later blast.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The encounter verb and the acoustic branch of the passive word-7 predicate.

A harsh piercing sound supplies an embodied acoustic event rather than a proposition.
A ladder as an ascending means supplies the imagined route to privileged audition.
Auditory perception supplies the privileged intake channel they implicitly claim.
Compelling proof supplies the evidentiary standard that the claimed hearing fails to meet.

changed_reading.before: They fail to prove what they claim to hear and are later punished.
changed_reading.after: Their day may answer claimed privileged hearing with a piercing event that operates as bodily counter-proof.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the fee-and-debt question denies that the messenger burdens them, yet its economic branches can still activate the possessive day as a due liability. It remains anchored in their event-day and what one meets of ill. Render it as a contrastive accounting analogy, not as a claim that the denied fee causes the punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The possessive event-day and the encounter branch for personally befalling ill.

activation_trace.role: What one meets of ill supplies experiential collection of the liability.

Compensation for work supplies the accounting frame explicitly denied as the messenger's demand.
A financial obligation that adheres supplies the image of a liability coming due.
Being loaded with a burden supplies the bodily weight of an accrued obligation.

changed_reading.before: Their day is only a date assigned from outside.
changed_reading.after: Their day can faintly read as a liability proper to them that comes due as encountered weight, despite no fee having been imposed by the messenger.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the post-focus night and star sequence as a model for the edge of their day. It remains anchored in the focus's open-span day and until-boundary, with context supplying awaited time, recession, and emergence. Render it as a temporal analogy, not as a claim that the focus day is an ordinary dawn.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The until-boundary and the open-span branch of the possessive day.

activation_trace.role: An open span of time allows the day to function as a phase rather than a sunrise-to-sunset unit.
Watching and awaiting a time supplies expectation directed toward a temporal edge.
Night's darkness supplies the preceding phase against which an edge can emerge.
The end of a thing and passage into its outcome supplies the turning boundary between phases.
What rises into visibility supplies a model for the event becoming finally manifest.

changed_reading.before: Their day is an arbitrary future timestamp.
changed_reading.after: Their day can be carried as a phase-boundary that becomes manifest when the preceding interval turns into its outcome.

strongest_changes: The opening command becomes disciplined, supervised restraint rather than abandonment.
Their hostile waiting is reversed: the interval they direct toward another's end closes upon their own event.
The possessive day marks liability and exposure rather than mastery, and it is where their own plot loses efficacy and aid.
The immediately preceding sky-fragment misclassification supplies a material route from detached appearance to sky-borne impact.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained coexisting causal models rather than one verdict: excess running to its limit, managed discourse ending in raw sound, denied control becoming passive exposure, self-turned plotting, a falling fragment becoming impact, and nearer penalties preceding the terminal threshold. The ladder-to-blast, debt-weight, and temporal-edge readings remain deliberately contained but live.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive shock can foreground piercing sound, sky-borne force, stunned consciousness, death, or a layered combination.
The short-of relation after the focus may be temporal, spatial, or hierarchical, which changes how much prior punishment the until-clause permits.
The fragment-to-impact, debt-weight, and ladder-to-blast mechanisms may be latent branch analogies rather than the main discourse mechanics.
The post-focus temporal edge may discipline the waiting interval without defining the nature of the possessive day itself.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dişi devenin, kadının ve daha geniş biçimde dişi hayvanın çabuk gebe kalmasını temel anlam olarak verir; ayrıca hızlı gebe kalan ile hızlı dölleyenin denk gelişini anlatan bir atasözü aktarır. Dal çerçevesi çekirdek nitelik ile kalıplaşmış örneği doğru biçimde ayırmaya elverişlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, dişinin çabuk gebe kalmasıdır; atasözü bu niteliğin iki uyumlu kişi için benzetmeli kullanımına bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçimin hızlı gebe kalma niteliği ile yalnız kalıplaşmış sözde görülen karşılıklı uygunluk kullanımı ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Dişi devenin, kadının veya başka bir dişi hayvanın çiftleşme sonrasında çabuk gebe kalma niteliğidir. Kalıplaşmış sözde bu hız, birbirine uygun iki kişinin denk gelmesine benzetilir.

facets.statement: Temel nitelik, dişinin çabuk gebe kalmasıdır.
Nitelik dişi deve yanında kadınlara ve genel olarak dişi hayvanlara da uygulanır.
Kalıplaşmış söz, hızlı gebe kalan ile hızlı dölleyenin denk gelişinden hareketle iki kişinin uyumunu anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar hızlı gebe kalma niteliğinde birleşir; kapsam dişi deveden kadınlara ve başka dişi hayvanlara uzanır. Aynı claim, bu niteliğe dayanan uyum atasözünü de içerir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dişi deve, kadın veya başka bir dişi hayvan için temel üreme niteliği anlatılırken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dişinin gebe kalma hızını açık ve doğal biçimde korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hızlı gebe kalan ile hızlı dölleyenin karşılaşmasına dayanan atasözü insan ilişkilerine uygulandığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İki tarafın birbirine uygun ve denk olması sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Benzetmenin hızlı gebe kalma ve hızlı dölleme temeline dayandığını tek başına göstermez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin çekirdeği iki tarafın karşı karşıya gelip buluşması veya bir şeyle karşılaşmadır. Aynı toplu ifade birini karşılamayı ve onun karşısında bulunmayı da içerdiği için dal yalnız karşılıklı buluşma diye daraltılamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Karşılıklı buluşma, rastlama, karşılama ve karşısında bulunma aynı ilişkisel alan içindedir; atma ve özel ticari karşılama bu dala genellenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak karşılaşma anlamı ile karşılama ve karşısında oturma gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmadan gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: İki tarafın karşı karşıya gelmesi, bir tarafın ötekiyle rastlaşması veya onu karşılamasıdır. Konumsal kullanımda birinin tam karşısında bulunmayı da anlatır.

facets.statement: İki kişi veya şey karşı karşıya gelir ya da biri ötekiyle rastlaşır.
Tek yönlü kullanımda bir kişi ötekini karşılamak üzere ona yönelir ve onu kabul eder.
Konumsal kullanım, birinin ötekinin tam karşısında ve hizasında bulunmasını anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıkların ortak çekirdeği karşılaşma ve yüz yüze gelmedir. Toplu claim ayrıca karşılama, rastlama ve karşısında bulunma kullanımlarını aynı ilişkisel alan içinde verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın karşılıklı, tek yönlü ve konumsal gerçekleşmelerini birlikte gösteren genel açıklama olarak uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Karşı karşıya gelme, rastlama, karşılama ve karşı konumu birlikte korur.

error_profile.loses: Birini karşılamaya gitme ve tam karşısında bulunma kullanımlarını tek başına taşımaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden atma veya bırakma hareketini çekirdek yapar. Sevginin birine yöneltilmesi ve çözülecek bir sözün birine sunulması, aynı yöneltme yapısının bağımlı kullanımlarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal atma ve bir hedefe yöneltme eylemidir; atılmış nesnenin kalıcı adı veya karşılıklı buluşma değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak atma eylemi ile sevgi yöneltme ve çözülecek söz sunma gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımlar ayrı belirtilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden atmak, bırakmak veya belirli bir alıcıya yöneltmektir. Sevgi yöneltme ve çözülmesi istenen bir sözü birine sunma, bu hareketin kalıplaşmış kullanımlarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir nesne bulunduğu yerden atılır, fırlatılır veya bırakılır.
Atılan ya da aktarılan şey belirli bir kişiye veya onun üzerine yöneltilebilir.
Soyut kullanımlarda sevgi birine yöneltilir veya çözmesi için birine bilmece niteliğinde söz sunulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar atma ve bırakma hareketinde birleşir. Toplu claim, bu hareketin bir alıcıya yönelmesini, sevgi aktarımını ve çözülmesi istenen sözün sunulmasını da kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal packet düzeyinde inceleme statüsünde tutulmuş sınır-riskli malzemeyi taşır. Kanıt, tek bir yalın kök imgesinden çok biçime veya özel kullanıma bağlı dağınık adlandırmaları gösterdiği için dal yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan sınırlı bir adlandırma kümesi olarak okunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dalın öğeleri genel kök anlamı gibi genişletilmemeli, birbirinin yerine geçebilen tek bir sözlük karşılığı sayılmamalı ve yalnız kanıtta verilen biçim veya bağlam sınırı içinde tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kanıt, dağ kenarındaki çıkıntı veya iki dağ arasındaki birleşim yeriyle rahim ağzındaki dalları ya da üreme organındaki dar geçitleri aynı biçim altında verir; coğrafi aktarım ve kök üyeliği ayrıca tartışmalıdır.

facets.statement: Coğrafi kullanım dağ kenarlarındaki çıkıntıları veya iki dağ arasındaki birleşim yerini adlandırır.
Anatomik kullanım rahim ağzındaki dalları ve daha aşağıdaki dar geçitleri adlandırır.
Coğrafi aktarım koşullu olarak sorgulanır ve benzer bir biçimin ilk ünsüzü kökün parçası sayılarak bu kökten ayrılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: İnceleme statüsündeki kanıt, tek bir birleşik anlamdan çok biçime veya özel bağlama bağlı sınırlı adlandırmaları gösterir; dal bu kayıtları kontrollü biçimde görünür tutar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bu karşılık, kanıttaki dağınık veya biçime bağlı adlandırma kümesini güvenli biçimde etiketler; tek ve birleşik bir sözlük anlamı değildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir canlının güçlü bir ses, duyusal sarsıntı, göksel çarpma, sıcaklık veya benzeri etkiyle bilincini yitirmesini ya da ölmesini anlatır. Dalın odağı neden olan ses veya olay değil, etkilenende gerçekleşen bilinç ve yaşam değişimidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal etkilenen canlının bayılması, sersemlemesi veya ölmesidir; güçlü sesin ya da göksel çarpmanın adı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, bayılma ve ölme bildiren biçimleri çekirdekte tutar; başkasını bu duruma sokan ettirgen kullanım ile göksel olayın birini vurduğu yapı ayrı uygulamalar olarak gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir canlının güçlü bir ses, göksel çarpma, aşırı sıcaklık, başka bir duyusal sarsıntı veya benzeri etki yüzünden bilincini yitirmesi, sersemlemesi ya da ölmesidir. Ettirgen kullanım, başkasını bu duruma sokmayı anlatır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, dış bir etkinin ardından bilincin yitmesi, aklın baştan gitmesi veya ölümle yaşamın sona ermesidir.
Tetikleyici güçlü ses veya göksel çarpmayla sınırlı değildir; aşırı sıcaklık ve benzeri etkiler de aynı durum değişimini doğurabilir.
Ettirgen biçimler başkasını bayıltmayı ya da öldürmeyi, olayla kurulan yüklemli yapı ise göksel çarpmanın kişide bu sonucu doğurmasını anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bilinç kaybı ile ölümü aynı dalın iki sonucu olarak verir. Güçlü ses ve göksel çarpma öne çıkan nedenlerdir; aşırı sıcaklık ve başka duyusal etkiler de kapsam içindedir, ayrıca ettirgen biçimler bu sonucu başkasına yöneltir.
